title: Discount narration requires a visible discount rather than ordinary shelf prices
rule: When a narrated clause says discount or price reduction, its visible asset must show an actual discount marker or an unambiguous old/new price relationship. Ordinary shelf prices, different products or different pack sizes alone do not establish a reduction.
action: Inspect the actual source and rendered crop beside the discount phrase; retain readable promotion/old-new labels and historical date, keep captions clear, and separate archival shelf offers from current prices or later hypothetical arithmetic.
rationale: Actual r06/c9 frame3121 had contextually relevant Vietnamese shelf-price photos but no visible reduction while the caption explicitly referred to a discount. r07 supplies an archival promotion label with crossed-out19.600 and15.400, whose date and limits remain visible.
applies_to: Discount and price-reduction clauses in original photo-led grocery/life explainers
Source selection and rendered-crop review for archival promotion images; not verification of current offers or customer behavior
